ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the query is a friendly, open-ended conceptual explanation, which maps to the "open-ended generative work" family. Dunlin both reports a strong preference for that family (win-rate 71) and edges out Curlew on the Creative Generation eval (81.2 vs 78.8, a difference above the 2.0 variance threshold). The two models are effectively tied on most other dimensions, so the generative-task fit was the deciding factor.
